results.typed_failure: AUR-017/AC-001/undecided-standard: standard SARIF matrix version (2.1.0) diverges from standards/contracts/versions.yaml (2.2.0)
AUR-017/AC-001/undecided-standard: standard SARIF source host is not allowlisted: evil.example.net

summary: Round 2, after round 1 (VETO: interoperability.md:27 and standards/contracts/unified-diff/validator.md:6 cited the live, unpinned www.gnu.org Detailed-Unified.html as proof of Unified diff 3.10/2023-05-21; refetched cru, that URL resolved to diffutils 3.12/2025-01-12 content, not 3.10 -- a citation that does not survive its own dereferencing, which is exactly what this card exists to prevent). Round 2 replaces the Source with the archived Wayback Machine snapshot (web.archive.org/web/20230527075044/..., whose frozen body reads 'version 3.10, 2 January 2023') and removes www.gnu.org from tests/specs/AUR-017/allowed-source-domains.txt in favor of web.archive.org. Reverted the fix surgically (Source back to the live www.gnu.org URL, nothing else touched): exit 1, AUR-017/AC-001/undecided-standard: standard Unified diff source host is not allowlisted: www.gnu.org -- the round-1 defect now fails mechanically, not just in prose, if reintroduced. Fetched both URLs directly outside the container: the archived snapshot's body contains 'version 3.10, 2 January 2023' (matches the pinned row); the live URL's body contains 'version 3.12, 12 January 2025' (confirms the round-1 defect was real and structural, not a transient fetch artifact). Both card-declared mutations executed live in the bootstrap-readonly-v1 container against the round-2 candidate: MUT-001 (SARIF version bumped to 2.2.0 in versions.yaml without migrating the matrix or fixtures) fails with the typed undecided-standard divergence message; MUT-002 (SARIF Source host replaced with evil.example.net) fails with the typed not-allowlisted message. Both restore byte-identical and the clean accept replays the same stdout digest (d44fc784...c2f6d8) twice. Attempted a subdomain-suffix allowlist bypass (web.archive.org.evil.com) -- rejected, exact-string host comparison. --network=none confirmed on both oci-run container invocations; no curl/wget/eval anywhere in the patch. APROVADO.
